name: Akizora no Memories ─Tokuiten no Kiseki─
original_name: アキゾラのメモリーズ ─特異点の奇跡─
source:
Wakaba lost her life to "Youth Deficiency Syndrome."

The protagonist Arata, alongside Chihaya, boards the "Frogvan" developed by Mr. Yoshizuka. They shift worldlines to save Waka.

However, in the shifted worldline, they encounter a different Waka unlike the one they knew.
"Rise again, time after time."

Overcoming numerous tragedies, Arata struggles to secure the worldline where his "wish" is granted.

[Machine Translated from [url=https://www.dmm.co.jp/dc/doujin/-/detail/=/cid=d_455648/]FANZA[/url]]
translation:
若叶因“青春缺乏症”而丧生。

主角新田和千早一起登上了吉冢先生开发的“青蛙车”。他们改变世界线来拯救瓦卡。

然而，在转移的世界线中，他们遇到了一个与他们所认识的不同的瓦卡。
“再次站起来，一次又一次。”

荒田克服了无数的悲剧，努力确保他的“愿望”得以实现的世界线。

[译自 [url=https://www.dmm.co.jp/dc/doujin/-/detail/=/cid=d_455648/]FANZA[/url]]
